name: Campingplatz Sankt Alban
beschreibung:
Situated directly at the water's edge, Campingplatz Sankt Alban provides guests with panoramic lake views stretching towards the alpine mountain peaks. The site offers manicured green grounds, modern sanitary amenities, and boat moorings.

Water sports fans, sailors, and swimmers will find ideal conditions, while the surrounding area features scenic cycling trails and family-friendly walking routes.
kurzbeschreibung: Campingplatz Sankt Alban impresses with a picturesque shoreline location and relaxing lakeside holiday charm.
